If I bleed with Dimple, he's blocked, and then I Hidden Lurker in

original acting minion?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jasper Phillips wrote:
>
> I'm still a little uncertain about just how Hidden Lurker works.
> If I bleed with Dimple, he's blocked, and then I Hidden Lurker in
> with Marty Lechtansi, can I untap Marty with Freak Drive? What
> if marty had Superior Fortitude? Or could I only play FD on the
> original acting minion?

No, since only the acting minion can play action modifiers (original
acting minion or otherwise). Marty is not the acting minion.
